name: Armorer Spells
description:
When you reach an Artificer level specified in the Armorer Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

Level 3: Magic Missile, Thunderwave

Level 5: Mirror Image, Shatter

Level 9: Hypnotic Pattern, Lightning Bolt

Level 13: Fire Shield, Greater Invisibility

Level 17: Passwall, Wall of Force
